Target company: Meta Platforms (META). Meta operates Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp and related social products; advertising is a major business activity. It also develops virtual and augmented reality products.

Focal announcement: Testing New Ways to Combat Scams and Help Restore Access to Compromised Accounts.

Decision cutoff: 2024-10-21T23:59:59-04:00. Use only information available before this cutoff.

Source: Testing New Ways to Combat Scams and Help Restore Access to Compromised Accounts. Published date: 2024-10-21. URL: https://about.fb.com/news/2024/10/testing-combat-scams-restore-compromised-accounts.

Condensed source passage, selected from the supplied excerpt; other details are omitted: Update on September 28, 2025 at 9:00PM PT: We’re now launching measures that use facial recognition technology to help detect and prevent scams and enable faster account recovery on our platforms in the United Kingdom (UK), European Union (EU) and South Korea. Also soon, people in the UK, EU and South Korea trying to recover access to Facebook or Instagram accounts will have a new option to verify their identity with a video selfie. We’re now testing video selfies as a means for people to verify their identity and regain access to compromised accounts. The user will upload a video selfie and we’ll use facial recognition technology to compare the selfie to the profile pictures on the account they’re trying to access.
